description: This file implements the Punycode algorithm from RFC 3492, including encoding and decoding functions, for handling internationalized domain names.

methods.name: punyError
methods.description: Returns an error indicating a Punycode decoding or encoding issue.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Punycode string into Unicode, as specified in RFC 3492 section 6.2.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode string into Punycode with a given prefix, as specified in RFC 3492 section 6.3.

methods.name: madd
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition with overflow detection.

methods.name: decodeDigit
methods.description: Converts a byte to its corresponding digit value in Punycode.

methods.name: encodeDigit
methods.description: Converts a digit value to its corresponding byte in Punycode.

methods.name: adapt
methods.description: Bias adaptation function as specified in section 6.1 of RFC 3492.
